headline: Researchers Document 'The 2 AM Entity': Figure Reported in Gas Station Parking Lots Nationwide
subheadline: Over 847 witness reports describe identical figure standing near air pumps between 2-3 AM
summary: A crowdsourced investigation has compiled hundreds of reports describing the same unmoving figure in gas station parking lots during a specific hour.
content:
It's always 2 AM. It's always near the air pump. And it's always standing perfectly still.

What started as a Threadit thread titled "Anyone else see the guy at gas stations late at night?" has evolved into a nationwide documentation effort with over 847 witness reports.

The descriptions are remarkably consistent: a figure standing motionless in gas station parking lots, typically between 2 and 3 AM. The figure is always positioned near the air pump or vacuum station. It never approaches. It never leaves while being watched. It's just there.

"I stopped for gas at 2:17 AM outside Millbrook," reported one witness. "Saw a guy standing by the air pump. Figured he was waiting to use it. Pumped my gas. He didn't move. Went inside, bought a coffee, came back out. Still there. Exact same position. I drove away. Checked my rearview. He was gone."

Mildred Gasketsworth, the retired insurance adjuster known for her gas station reviews, confirmed she has seen the figure during her late-night travels. "Flying J #847 in Sioux City. 2:34 AM. I was reviewing the sushi selection when I noticed him through the window. Standing by the air pump. I've seen a lot of things in gas station parking lots, but that one... that one wasn't waiting for anything earthly."

Attempts to photograph the entity have been largely unsuccessful. Images either show nothing, show blur, or—in 47 documented cases—show the figure facing the camera despite witnesses insisting it was facing away.

"The freaky part isn't that he's there," wrote u/LateNightFillUp, who moderates the documentation Threadit. "The freaky part is how many different gas stations. How many different states. Same guy. Same posture. Same time. Either this is the most dedicated performance artist in history, or it's something else."

Gas station chains have not responded to requests for comment. Security camera footage from the documented times is, according to multiple station managers, "corrupted," "missing," or "shows static for exactly one hour."

The community advises witnesses not to approach, not to acknowledge, and not to return to their vehicle until after 3 AM.

"He's never done anything," wrote one researcher. "But 847 people have seen the same thing. That's not nothing. That's a pattern. That's a schedule."
author: Sandra Mitchell, Local News
